{{Top|leg}}
A '''thought shield''', also sometimes called a '''mental shield''', was a [[Force power/Legends|Force technique]] used by [[The Force/Legends|Force]] users in order to keep their thoughts, emotions, and motives secret from others. It was taught from the earliest age, to [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]], apprentices, and sometimes even diplomats, in order to keep their thoughts and emotions from [[Telepathy/Legends|being read and interpreted]].

In battle, this was crucial as an enemy may sometimes be able to predict an unshielded opponent's next movement and easily counterattack or evade their attacks. Apparently, all that was involved in the shield was a strong, mental will, and the ability to concentrate for long periods of time. Eventually, this concentration would become second nature, and subconscious. By focusing, a being could raise and lower the shield as they saw fit, but usually it was kept raised.

[[Atton Rand]] was particularly skilled in this technique, having been trained in the [[Echani (martial art)/Legends|Echani arts]] to [[Jedi hunter/Legends|hunt]] down Jedi during his days as a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] special forces unit. His main method of this was to "play pazaak," albeit in his mind, as a way to keep it occupied. While he was for the most part effective in this, he was nevertheless unable to block out [[Kreia]]'s telepathic abilities. During his time with [[Meetra Surik]], he also taught her this ability.<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] made use of this power when [[Dooku/Legends|Darth Tyranus]] [[Drain Knowledge|invaded his mind]] while he was a captive on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref>''[[Precipice]]''</ref> [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] also used a thought shield as a mental barrier against the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]] when he was attempting to turn her to his side during the [[Thrawn campaign]].<ref name="The Last Command">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>
